title: Siege of Neamț Citadel
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Neamț Citadel", at revision 1370743934, opens: "The Siege of Neamț Citadel took place during the Moldavian–Ottoman War. It was conducted by the Ottoman army of Mehmed the Conqueror against the Moldavian garrison of Stephan the Great. It took place on c. August 1476." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3625463, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1476 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
